correctness.rationale: All finite claims were independently replayed from committed generators only. A from-scratch semigroup-tree BFS (N0=<1>, children=S minus one right minimal generator >F) reproduced per-genus counts 23,39,67,118,204,343,592 (total 1386), exactly matching census.json and OEIS A007323. A second independent sieve path (gcd=1, bounded membership sieve, Ap minima, Kunz=(Ap[i]-i)/m with sum=g, |L|=c-g, generator minimality by subset reachability, PF={gaps x: x+gens subset S}, W=e|L|-c) verified all 1386 rows: Ap/Kunz/Lsize/e/t/W all match, W>=0 everywhere with min 0 in every genus, max t=g uniquely (ordinary semigroup <g+1..2g+1>) in every genus, W=0 counts 6,3,4,5,6,2,9 for g=6..12 as claimed. All 63 (g,m) strata: stratum sizes N, max-type values, min-Wilf values, and witness membership/optimality confirmed; tree-set vs census-set equality holds per genus (0 missing/extra). verify.py returns VERIFY_OK. Result is a finite machine-checked certificate (computational proof for genus 6-12), not a general Wilf theorem; scope explicitly limited to 6-12.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp/failed-search: Delgado-Eliahou-Fromentin 2310.07742 verifies boolean Wilf to genus 100 (plus n73-75) with trimmed-tree parallel enumeration — so W>=0 at 6-12 alone is subsumed — but publishes no per-semigroup (F,e,t,W,Apery,Kunz) table and no multiplicity-stratified max-type/min-Wilf witnesses at 6-12. Bras-Amoros 2306.14034 verifies Wilf to 66 via seeds/RGD with counts and Eliahou existence at 66-67, not a low-genus per-semigroup certificate. Marashdeh 2608.12531 proves general type bound typ<=e-1+Xii and Wilf reduction, no genus 6-12 census. OEIS A007323 records only counts n_g. ArXiv all-fields search 'numerical semigroup type Wilf genus' returns 3 hits, none a genus 6-12 Wilf/type census. GAP NumericalSgps is an unquoted tool that can compute single invariants, not a published stratified extremal table. The per-(g,m) exact maxima/minima with named witnesses (e.g. (11,6) minW=3 at [6,7,16]; (10,5) minW=0 at [5,6]; (12,12) minW=10) are newly computed boundary facts requiring exhaustive search, not transcriptions or mechanical implications.

value.rationale: Headline is a complete exact invariant table plus extremal boundary facts for a natural object motivated before computation: Wilf conjecture (1978) W>=0 open, Froberg-Gottlieb-Haggkvist type-vs-e sufficient condition, and Eliahou-number program; Bras-Amoros enumeration and Delgado-Garcia-Sanchez type work create demand for replayable low-genus fragments as base cases/pruning anchors. Genus 6-12 is the window where multiplicity/type diversification first appears yet remains exhaustively certifiable. While global max-type=g (ordinary) alone is elementary (t<=g since PF subset gaps), the 63-stratum interior extrema are non-obvious (many minW>0, e.g. 10 at (12,12), 9 at (11,11); non-ordinary witnesses throughout) and were unknown, not mechanically implied, and reasonably needed as cited exact values. This is a rigorously established exact invariant set of a specific natural family, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration: every value carries generators, Apery/Kunz tables, and optimality certificate. Census is complete (tree equality proved by re-enumeration), so no incomplete-census discount applies.
